newsitem.title: MEXICO: Companies to make Mexico Northeast Railway payment.
newsitem.headline: Companies to make Mexico Northeast Railway payment.

text.p: Transportation company Transportacion Maritima Mexicana said on Thursday that it and business partner Kansas City Southern Industries will pay 4.429 billion pesos on Friday for its 40 percent share of the Northeast Railway concession.
The companies won a concession for the Mexican railway last month with a bid of 11.07 billion pesos.
TMM said in a statement that the Mexican government, through its Ferrocarriles Nacionales de Mexico, has decided to become a partner in the railway, by taking an equity position in July.
It said the decision was taken due to the "strategic" character of the railway.
TMM said that the total financing for the purchase of the railway has been assured by a banking consortium led by Morgan Stanley.
